meta.title: About - Antiwordle
meta.description: Learn about Antiwordle, a daily reverse word game where the objective is to avoid the hidden answer.

sections.title: A reverse word puzzle
body: Antiwordle turns the familiar daily word puzzle format upside down. The goal is not to solve the word quickly, but to survive as many valid guesses as possible before the answer becomes unavoidable.
The game is built around simple rules, visible constraints, and a daily shared challenge.

sections.title: Why it feels different
body: Every guess can make your next move harder. A correct letter is not just helpful information; it is a new restriction you must carry forward.
That makes Antiwordle feel more like a puzzle of controlled mistakes than a race to the answer.
